title: The batch gate bisects a reverted tip to revert a second culprit and reach verified
description: Run the real loop cycle against a real temporary Postgres control plane and a scratch bare Git remote: a batch with two culprits for the smoke check and an innocent change between them reverts both culprits, keeps the innocent change, reaches verified, and the deploy watch serves the verified tip.

steps.name: Gate a batch with two culprits for one check through the real loop
